title: POPP Gotchi Score
tagline: 🍿 POPP Gotchi Score will give Accountability  Score base on your Aavegotchi on-chain activities
description:
Accountability is essential for (Gamer) Community building, OTC trading & deal Financial service. A due diligence service and decentralized Badge System is more trustworthy and can be composable to other services or Dapp to identify and verify. 

Proof of Play Protocol (a.k.a 🍿 POPP) Gochi score will
- Collect and analyze address' On-chain record of gaming (currently gather address' Aavegochi on-chain activities)
- give accountability score based on address-owned NFTs, staking, DAO voting... 
- mint address certified NFT signed by 🍿 POPP
how_its_made:
Prove your Gamfi credit via 🍿 POPP certified NFT



1. gather address Aavegotchi on-chain activities



- Use the graph aavegotchi-core-matic to query Aavegotchi NFTs ownership on Polygon

- Use Snapshot to query vote activities

- Use Zapper to query staking activities on Polygon



2. given Accountability Score based on address owned NFTs, staking, DAO voting... 



- process above gathered data and give the score



3. mint address certified NFT signed by 🍿 POPP



- signed the score data from our server, pass the data and hash to contract to mint the NFT
